key_points: Dutch court blocks Keytruda in Europe, a legal setback for Merck's flagship drug
Morgan Stanley lowered Merck's price target, reflecting concern over the Keytruda ruling
Cantor Fitzgerald raised its price target citing a stronger 2027 outlook
JPMorgan also raised its price target, offsetting some negative sentiment
Mixed institutional activity: some buying (Congress Asset Management, Worth Asset Management) and some selling (Canandaigua National Bank, Argent Capital)
